#What I like about voat.co

So I noticed a few things about voat. First of all, it has some of RES features right from the go, like opening pictures without clicking on the link. I never really used it that much, but it's nice that they see what users probably like. Also they have side wide commenting formats for [](#s "Spoilers."). That is very cool. I never liked how in reddit some subreddits marked spoilers by setting them nsfw. Some subs would make spoilers show in the alt text, some had black bars that went away when hovering over the spoiler. This meant that users sometimes fell into spoiler traps or never got to see the text, because it was different in every sub. Also you had to learn the comment syntax, here it is right at the top. I also like how they are handling spam bots. First of all they have recaptcha, but also you have to gain comment points before you can actually post anything.
